title: RADIUS: replace ULI decoder with version from GTPv2
description:
Reuse the DIAMETER dissector for 3GPP-ULI for RADIUS as well.

The DIAMETER dissector for 3GPP-ULI IE is more complete than the RADIUS version. The format of the IE is the same in RADIUS and DIAMETER.
